subject: HSM operator shift logs + deletion attestation for delta-payments
messages:
From: Paul Tan <paul.tan@deltacorp.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: HSM operator shift logs + proof of deletion for decommissioned keys

Hi Lauren,

We're preparing for DeltaCorp's SIG assessment next month and need a few items to close our KMS/HSM controls related to the "delta-payments" tenant:

- Operator shift logs (HSM audit trail) for 2027-04-01 through 2027-06-30
- Proof of key deletion (keystore manifests and deletion timestamps) for keys retired in Q1/Q2 2027
- A short attestation that key deletion followed your documented retention schedule and the deletion process

Please deliver the artifacts via secure SFTP or a DocuSign/attestation letter (whichever is easier). We prefer encrypted transfer and a signed attestation.

Attaching our SIG request cover: DeltaCorp_Sig-Request_20270521.pdf (see attachment stub)

Thanks,
Paul Tan
CISO, DeltaCorp
paul.tan@deltacorp.com

Attachment: DeltaCorp_Sig-Request_20270521.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Paul Tan <paul.tan@deltacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: HSM operator shift logs + proof of deletion for decommissioned keys

Hi Paul,

Thanks for the request — we can provide the HSM operator shift logs and deletion manifests. Proposed delivery plan:

1) Ben will produce HSM audit trail extracts and the keystore deletion manifests (CSV/JSON).
2) Marissa will assemble a brief attestation letter mapping artifacts to SIG/CAIQ control IDs.
3) We'll deliver via secure SFTP link and provide a time-limited access credential. If you require DocuSign, we can also provide a signed PDF.

Questions for you before we pull logs:
- Do you need operator usernames redacted? (We can provide obfuscated IDs and a key to map them under NDA.)
- Are deletion manifests required to include key material identifiers (key IDs) or only timestamps & operator actions?

Target delivery: 2027-05-24 EOD PT. Let us know if you need an earlier turnaround.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: Request-Ack.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Paul Tan <paul.tan@deltacorp.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: HSM operator shift logs + proof of deletion for decommissioned keys

Paul / Lauren,

Attached are the artifacts per Lauren's plan. Delivering via secure SFTP and including a manifest of files below. Sensitive fields have been redacted per our internal policy; we include a mapping file under NDA if required.

SFTP: sftp://redwood-secure.example.com/delta-payments/20270524 (creds shared via separate channel)

Attachments (stubs):
- hsm_shiftlogs_202704-202706.csv (text/csv)
- keystore_deletion_manifest_delta-payments.json (application/json)
- deletion_timestamps_202701-202706.csv (text/csv)

Notes:
- The HSM audit trail includes event timestamps, op type, op result, operator_id (internal). We have redacted operator email addresses; operator_id is a short alphanumeric.
- We used our standard retention hash to verify deletion; the deletion manifest includes HSM GUIDs and timestamp. We do not include secret key material.

Let me know if you need any additional fields or a different file format.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: hsm_shiftlogs_202704-202706.csv; keystore_deletion_manifest_delta-payments.json

From: Paul Tan <paul.tan@deltacorp.com>

Date: 2027-05-24T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: HSM operator shift logs + proof of deletion for decommissioned keys

Thanks, Ben — this looks good. Two items before we close the SIG ticket:

1) Can you provide a signed attestation letter confirming deletions followed Redwood's retention schedule and deletion process? We need an authorized signature.
2) Please provide a simple retention schedule PDF that shows retention windows and deletion triggers for tenant keys.

If possible, please send a DocuSign link for the attestation. Happy to sign on our side once we receive it.

Regards,
Paul
